'''Panera''' (spoken as '''Steve''' on Discord and GEMP) was a guest on the first [[Holotheatre]] Tales episode, ''The Battle of Hoth'', on 23 October 2024, with [[Clayton Moore]] and the Calgary scene.<ref name="ht-ropEbMxYKXs">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ropEbMxYKXs&t=280s Star Wars CCG Presents: Holotheatre Tales Episode 1: The Battle of Hoth], Star Wars CCG (23 October 2024). Preserved copy: pending Wayback. Spoken identification 4:40.</ref>
